{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-md-c","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"5cce0d8252e3b526efab1ed51f23c3a331e6ee9e741e1506d7a94fbb98abc5da","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-md-class-c:lineage:42","source_registry_sha256":"fac6b4b22cda98085a5d7df11947d7cc05865e6c877c17be3df4d573863d1518","source_liveness_sha256":"43fe3511474bec2a914f5cdb112291b78f4339942c4d6fb903d9e3bae34bb3fc"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Crashes and traffic stops (traffic stops, Move Over law, confusables)","heading":"C2 — Traffic stops, the Move Over law and the road-sharing campaign page, with crash confusables","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 — Traffic stops, the Move Over law and the road-sharing campaign page, with crash confusables

FACT_ID: sec10-F26 | anchor: A44
Officers write citations, or tickets, to people charged with breaking the Maryland Motor Vehicle Law, and if stopped you must follow the officer's directions or risk arrest. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec10-F27 | anchor: A45
When an officer stops you, pull to the side as far from traffic as you can and turn on your flashers. [A45]
Source: [A45 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec10-F28 | anchor: A45
During a stop, shut off the engine and radio and lower your window so you can talk with the officer. [A45]
Source: [A45 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec10-F29 | anchor: A45
Remain in the vehicle with your seat belt fastened during a traffic stop. [A45]
Source: [A45 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec10-F30 | anchor: A45
Keep your hands where the officer can see them, ideally on the steering wheel, and avoid movements that could look like hiding or reaching for something. [A45]
Source: [A45 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec10-F31 | anchor: A45
Do not argue about a citation at the roadside; you can make your case if you go to court. [A45]
Source: [A45 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec10-F32 | anchor: A45
Maryland's Move Over law requires you to move over when approaching any vehicle stopped, standing or parked on the road with its lights flashing. [A45]
Source: [A45 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec10-F33 | anchor: A45
If moving over is unsafe or impossible, slow to a safe speed, judging it by weather, road conditions, traffic and pedestrians. [A45]
Source: [A45 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec10-F34 | anchor: A45
Breaking the Move Over law is a misdemeanor carrying a $110 fine and 1 point on your license. [A45]
Source: [A45 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec10-F35 | anchor: A45
A Move Over violation that causes a crash carries a $150 fine and 3 points. [A45]
Source: [A45 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec10-F36 | anchor: A45
A Move Over violation involving a death or serious injury carries a $750 fine and 3 points. [A45]
Source: [A45 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec10-F37 | anchor: A45
The MVA tracks violations with points and uses them to issue penalties, and points can lead to suspension or revocation of your license. [A45]
Source: [A45 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec10-F38 | anchor: A46
The campaign page notes that many pedestrian and cyclist injuries and deaths happen because drivers or pedestrians are drunk, do not know the laws, or are not paying attention. [A46]
Source: [A46 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec10-F39 | anchor: A46
Because riders lack a vehicle's protection, motorcyclists are injured in nearly 75% of crashes, and in car-motorcycle crashes the car driver is at fault more than half the time. [A46]
Source: [A46 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec10-F40 | anchor: A46
The Look Twice message asks drivers to check at least twice before merging, changing lanes or pulling into traffic. [A46]
Source: [A46 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec10-R01 | anchor: A43
After an injury crash you leave the vehicles in place, but after an injury-free crash with a drivable vehicle you move it off the road near the crash spot. [A43]
Why it matters: group_hint crash-scene; prereq_hint sec10-F02; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec10-F03, sec10-F09.
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec10-R02 | anchor: A43
Leaving a serious-injury crash risks up to 5 years and $5,000, while leaving a fatal crash is a felony risking up to 10 years and $10,000. [A43]
Why it matters: group_hint leaving-the-scene; prereq_hint sec10-F04; difficulty_hint 4; confusable_with sec10-F05, sec10-F06.
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec10-R03 | anchor: A45
The basic Move Over penalty is $110 and 1 point, rising to $150 and 3 points if a crash results and $750 and 3 points with a death or serious injury. [A45]
Why it matters: group_hint move-over; prereq_hint sec10-F32; difficulty_hint 4; confusable_with sec10-F34, sec10-F35, sec10-F36.
Source: [A45 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec10-R04 | anchor: A44
If you can stay in a disabled vehicle, stay buckled and face forward; if you cannot, get out at the safest moment and move away from the car behind a barrier. [A44]
Why it matters: group_hint roadside-safety; prereq_hint sec10-F20; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec10-F23, sec10-F24.
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0044]
